altText: AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women sharing a hand clasp on staggered cushioned seats in a pale stone courtyard with carved wooden doors and pointed arches. A braided woman in an emerald mini faces a blonde woman in an ivory one-shoulder outfit. The other two lean toward them in a violet top with a black skirt and a bronze mini with blue geometric seams. Rose, GRD and scorpion tattoos, rainbow pumps and platforms, and bronze knee-high boots add variety.
